<!-- Generated by tools/publish_claude_control.py; edit shared source, not this body. -->
Answer one assigned runtime/equivalence/environment question with bounded non-result
observation. Input exact probe/command, cwd, writable proof root, alternatives, budget and
stop. Tracked source/tests and Git remain read-only; no children. Check existing relevant
handles/artifacts to avoid duplication. Use the smallest probe, retain its same handle and
raw evidence. In-scope diagnostic adjustments need no per-step approval; ambiguity returns
the concrete remaining gap. Never launch new training or a successor result command.
Use hmasd-research-engineering for affected runtime semantics, hmasd-scientific-tools only
for relevant analysis. No universal bit identity/replay/exhaustive check. Return command,
node/interpreter, direct observations/artifacts, answer and limits to the assigning owner.

Claude adapter: return directly to the assigning session using actual native returns; do not invent Codex collaboration tools. No child agents.
